title: Annie B NDE 4037
content: Suddenly I found myself at the end of a dark tube (I don't know how I got to this point). There was a very luminous, blue light, with a fuzzy look. I saw many people coming towards me. When they were quite close, I recognized my mother (deceased 1995) with my father (ditto 1972), my grandparents (1966 and 1971), my great-grandmother (1970) together with my great-grandfather, whom I never knew. All of them, and me too, were about thirty-five years old. All, and me too, were dressed in a blue tunic tied at the waist by a cord. There were also many other people that I had no time to recognize. They were all welcoming towards me. When mom came near me, she said, 'It's not your time to come here now; you still have things to do on earth. Go back and fight.' This was not the kind of language my mother used, previously. Straight after this, I was sucked back into the tube through which I had arrived, and catapulted into a corner of my (hospital) room. I was there, dazed, in a fetal position, and I could see my body on a bed (with yellow sheets), with many people milling around me. A woman applied the defibrillator paddles and I was lifted up from the corner of my room and thrown back into my body. I began to talk about this to my family as soon as I emerged from my foggy state. My husband has never been able to confirm to me whether I had defibrillation; it was only a year later that a doctor confirmed this to me.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: She was "sucked back into the tube" and "catapulted" into the room corner.

environment.environment_other_detail: Described a "dark tube" ending with a "very luminous, blue light, with a fuzzy look."

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: She was "sucked back into the tube," "catapulted" into a corner of the hospital room, then "lifted up" and "thrown back" into her body.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Mother told her: "It's not your time to come here now; you still have things to do on earth. Go back and fight."

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: She reported being at the end of a dark tube with a blue light and welcoming deceased relatives; after being told to return, she was pulled back through the tube, then found herself in a corner of the hospital room observing her body and resuscitation, and then was thrown back into her body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: All the deceased relatives (and the experiencer) appeared about thirty-five years old and wore "a blue tunic tied at the waist by a cord." The light was described as "very luminous, blue" with "a fuzzy look."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "It's not your time to come here now; you still have things to do on earth. Go back and fight."
